cues.text: Hand-drawn now. A sunlit rooftop, seen from high above.
Two figures on a bench far below.
Wind turbines turn against a bright sky.
Across the rooftop, the friends wait at the open door.
Aigis turns to them and smiles.
On the bench, the hero leans against Aigis, eyes closed. Her hand rests on his shoulder.
His face is calm, a faint smile. Petals drift past.
